# Next.js buildout rules (plugin) — run ONCE during repo creation, then discarded.
# One-time structural check on the Next.js production build; the ongoing Next.js
# judgment (server-action input validation) lives in shapes/nextjs.llmlint.yml,
# and the shared web-app buildout rule covers the generic prod-build case.
version: 1

rules:
  - name: next_build_gates_type_and_lint_errors
    description: |
      true when CI runs `next build` and type/lint errors are build blockers — the
      Next.js config does not set `typescript.ignoreBuildErrors` or
      `eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds` to silence them. false when the production build is
      never run in CI, or errors are configured away so a broken build ships.
    files:
      include: [".github/workflows/**", "next.config.*", "justfile", "Justfile", ".justfile"]
